title_en: Orange Concert: Wednesday, October 21, 18:00, Building 38 Ground-Floor Pilotis
summary: The department announces an Orange Concert on Wednesday, October 21, at 18:00 in the pilotis (open ground-floor area) on the first floor of Building 38. The notice does not say who should attend or whether attendance is required. Only the title of the notice was provided, so any further details in the full notice were not read.
applies_to: Not stated. The notice does not say who may or must attend, and it does not say that attendance is mandatory.
conditions: Only the notice title was available. Any body text, attachments or images were not read and may contain further conditions.
steps: The notice title gives the Orange Concert start time and place: 18:00 on Wednesday, October 21, at the first-floor pilotis of Building 38.
translation:
Title: Notice of the Orange Concert (Wednesday, October 21, 18:00, Building 38, 1st Floor Pilotis [38동 1층 필로티])

Note: Only the title of this notice was provided. No body text, attachment or image was available, so none was read or translated.
